description: Discards the job's tailored résumé and its approval, then tailors it again with an AI model from the saved résumé, and returns the new résumé with what changed. Refused once the application was sent or is sending.

idempotency_key.description: Repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns its first result instead of acting again.

job_id.description: A job id from search_jobs, get_job_from_link or list_applications.

name: regenerate_tailored_resume

approved.description: Whether this résumé is the one approved to send with the application.

changes.description: What changed against the saved résumé.

added.description: Lines the tailored résumé has that the saved one does not.

items.description: One résumé line the tailoring added.

removed.description: Lines the saved résumé has that the tailored one does not.

items.description: One résumé line the tailoring dropped.

job_id.description: The job id the résumé is tailored to.

notes.description: What the tailoring did and left out, as it reported it.

resume_sha256.description: The tailored PDF's hash; approve_tailored_resume takes it.

title: Regenerate tailored résumé
